bilingualCollateral.observation: '污染的 MRSA 专用设备' is ambiguous between 'device dedicated to a MRSA client' (intended) and 'device dedicated for MRSA use' (a category of equipment). The sibling's own glossary renders the concept as '只用于同一名患者或同一隔离房间的设备', and the sibling q4_c token uses the clearer 'C 患者专用听诊器'. Advisory only: '该 MRSA 患者的专用设备' would remove the ambiguity.

'unit leadership' is rendered '当班管理人员' (on-duty/shift supervisor), which narrows the English to the charge nurse specifically. Consistent with the sibling's charge-nurse framing, so not misleading here, but '病区管理人员' would track the English more closely.

The zh adds '协助清洁时' ('while assisting with cleaning'), which has no counterpart in the English 'While the nurse is gowned and gloved in Room 12'. A small unilateral addition; it does not change who committed the linen-bagging error or its classification.

The zh prefixes 'T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)' where the English gives only 'T 38.4 C', and renders 'output about 1,100 mL' as '尿液和粪便总出量约 1,100 mL', specifying urine-plus-stool where the English is unspecified. The added Fahrenheit value is arithmetically consistent (38.4 °C = 101.1 °F); both are unilateral zh elaborations rather than errors.

All glossary entries provide termEn, termZh, and defZh but no defEn, so an English-only learner receives terms without definitions. This is a consistent structural pattern across both artifacts rather than a defect introduced by either, and it touches no keyed token.

reasoning:
Applying the fixed precedence in order:

(1) FAIL_HIDDEN_CASE_DEPENDENCY — not triggered. The standalone blind record reached the canonical set C1 / [A4, A3] / [P2, P3] token-for-token with no access to the sibling, and the standalone-unblinding record documented why the set is forced by the item's own text: C2 is self-described as a 'potential' concern awaiting policy verification, C3 is one localized surface, A1 explicitly declines to clean the counter or assess nearby supplies, A2 defers an active exposure for a full shift, and P1/P4 are individual-client treatment-response measures that evaluate nothing about environmental containment. Two of four action tokens and two of four parameter tokens are excludable on their own face, so the keyed pairs are determinate once C1 is fixed. Every sibling fact that touches a keyed token (the ~20-minute elapsed time, the counter placement, 'Client C's dedicated stethoscope', the unit policy's wet-contact-time rule, the ungowned daughter, the end-of-shift retrieval and disinfection) confirms the standalone reading rather than supplying a premise the learner needed. Sibling necessity is therefore nil; all overlap is corroborative.

(2) FAIL_UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN_PREMISE — considered and not triggered, though this is the closest call. Two keyed tokens carry client-specific qualifiers the standalone stem never states: C1's 'MRSA dedicated device' and A4's 'its designated isolation room' both presuppose the stethoscope was assigned single-client equipment, and P2's 'visitor ... PPE compliance on subsequent room entries' presupposes a visitor who enters an isolation room. The sibling supplies the antecedents (Room 16 'Dedicated stethoscope and blood-pressure cuff are in the room'; Client C's daughter repositioning her father in street clothes). But neither gap is load-bearing for ranking. Whether the device is dedicated or shared unit equipment, it is the only token describing contamination of a shared clean-supply area, so C1 outranks C2 and C3 either way; A4's remaining components (remove, disinfect contacted surfaces, assess supplies per policy, full wet-contact time) are independently sufficient to defeat A1 and A2; and P2 remains the only defensible second parameter because P1 and P4 fail on relevance, not on a missing premise. Unstated-but-uncontradicted qualifiers that cannot reverse any ordering are collateral, not a token-premise failure.

(3) FAIL_UNDERDETERMINED — not triggered. Exactly one condition, one action pair, and one parameter pair survive elimination; the blind record classified the pool ANSWERABLE and that classification holds against the revealed key.

(4) FAIL_CANONICAL_KEY_OR_LOGIC — not triggered. The key is clinically and logically sound. Prioritization by scope and directness of the transmission pathway (shared clean-supply stock versus one door handle) is the correct principle, matching the sibling's own q4 rationale. A4's sequence is clinically correct, A3's education-plus-documentation is standard breach follow-up, and P2/P3 are process indicators appropriate to a short evaluation window — the sibling's q6 makes the same point explicitly by rejecting same-shift infection rates (q6_b) as proof of effectiveness.

(5) HOLD_REVIEWER_DISAGREEMENT — not triggered. My blind selection and the canonical key agree completely; the only divergence is the listed order of P2 and P3 within an unordered pair.

Verdict: PASS_STANDALONE, with three narrow collateral observations recorded below at advisory P2. Note that the standalone-unblinding record's one self-correction (downgrading P2's rankability impact from MATERIAL to LOW once the full pool was visible) is unaffected by the sibling and stands as written.
